notes.basis: Separate accessory for the existing V6 diameter 46 x 13.5 mm puck. Keyboard case height is inherited from the magnetic dock; it is not a measurement of your keyboard.
notes.fit_required: Requires 56 mm of straight, closed case edge, a bare 4 mm top ledge, and a clear 14 mm underside strip. Keep clear of moving keys, ports, feet, and the keyboard suspension mount. Do not clamp a bare PCB or switches.
notes.angle: Fixed 15 degrees toward the keyboard, relative to the keyboard case plane. Rebuild to change the angle; there is no live hinge.
notes.suspension: The keyboard's own mount supports the keyboard. This accessory carries only the puck from the keyboard case; it is not a suspension anchor.
notes.padding: 0.8 mm is the installed pad thickness on each jaw. Use firm rubber with adhesive backing, including the adhesive in the measurement.
notes.status: CAD prototype. Physical fit, clamp friction, printed strength and long-term creep have not been load-tested.
